scripts.build: tsc -b && rm -rf dist && vite build --base=/ --outDir dist/client && node scripts/generate-static-routes.mjs && mkdir -p dist/server && cp worker/index.js dist/server/index.js
scripts.build:pages: tsc -b && rm -rf dist && vite build --outDir dist/client && node scripts/generate-static-routes.mjs
scripts.store:check: node --check store-worker/src/index.js && node --test store-worker/test/*.test.js && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config store-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.store:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply one-more-photon-orders --local --config store-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.store:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply one-more-photon-orders --remote --config store-worker/wrangler.jsonc
